product.name: AutoStream
product.tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators
product.description: AutoStream helps content creators automate their video editing workflow using AI — saving hours of manual editing time every week.

refund.policy: No refunds after 7 days from the date of purchase.
refund.details: Refunds are only available within the first 7 days. After that period, all charges are final.

support.basic_plan: Standard support during business hours (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm EST).
support.pro_plan: 24/7 priority support is available exclusively on the Pro plan.

policies.cancellation: You may cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of your billing period.
policies.free_trial: No free trial currently offered; refund window within first 7 days acts as a risk-free period.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream exports in formats compatible with YouTube, Instagram, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade at any time. You'll be charged the Pro rate prorated for the rest of your billing cycle.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: We do not currently offer a free trial, but you can get a refund within the first 7 days if you're not satisfied.
